description: This Java class 'OrangeHrmConfig' provides configuration management for the OrangeHRM UI tests by loading parameters from environment variables, including base URL, admin credentials, browser type, and headless mode setting.

classes.name: OrangeHrmConfig
classes.description: Configuration holder class for OrangeHRM UI test settings, loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: fromEnv
methods.description: Creates an OrangeHrmConfig instance by loading environment variables, optionally requiring secrets.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the configured base URL for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getAdminUsername
methods.description: Returns the admin username configured in environment variables.

methods.name: getAdminPassword
methods.description: Returns the admin password configured in environment variables.

methods.name: getBrowser
methods.description: Returns the browser type (e.g., chrome, firefox) specified in environment variables.

methods.name: isHeadless
methods.description: Indicates whether headless mode is enabled for the browser.
